tool_schema: Exact unchanged production submit_review_proposal definition; no tool_choice or response_format enforcement

instructions.concise: plan.json concise_addendum appended to the exact original system instruction

interpretation.delivery: Concise instruction removes observed 384-token truncation in 2/2; production-sized 2048 also removes truncation for both instruction variants in 4/4.
interpretation.factual_correctness: Only two of eight full contracts pass; concise 1/2 at each ceiling, original 0/2 at each ceiling. Four of six delivery-admitted conclusions contain factual contradictions or unsupported defects.
interpretation.normalization: Zero additional admissible factual successes; do not fix truncated JSON or accept correct rejection alone.
interpretation.confidence: Two unseeded repetitions per condition, same public fixture, balanced order but unequal prefix cache; not statistical proof of prompt reliability or runtime advantage.

production_decision.smallest_candidate_change: Existing finalization instruction only: prioritize a concise observed counterexample and named evidence; omit unverified causal explanations and speculative extra defects, or state specific uncertainty. The tested addendum is not qualified as a reliable production correction. Further task-diverse prospective qualification is needed before promotion.
